authentication_rule: Package status is only claimed-verified or unverified; consumer-authenticated record IDs are separate policy inputs.
edge_direction: Earlier ClaimVersion records may be targeted by later Relation, Evidence, Assessment, and UseReceipt overlays; earlier records never enumerate later overlays.

identity_profiles.claim_id: SHA-256 ni URI over protocol_version, record_type, exact statement, and exact scope
identity_profiles.package_root: SHA-256 ni URI over restricted-canonical manifest without package_root
identity_profiles.record_id: SHA-256 ni URI over the entire restricted-canonical record without record_id
identity_profiles.search_fingerprint: versioned lossy retrieval aid; never an identity

structural_assurance: Conformance and hash validity do not certify truth, novelty, completeness, reproduction, peer review, or fitness for use.
